heading: INT. STAGECOACH WAY STATION, DINING ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. STAGECOACH WAY STATION, DINING ROOM - NIGHT
A low adobe room.
A long plank table, a kerosene lamp, five tin plates.
Rain drums the roof.
AMOS GRISWOLD-TAYLOR (60s, station keeper) ladles stew.

At the table sit the evening's passengers: CLEMENTINE ROSSITER (30s, a widow's veil pushed back), ISIDRO VALDEZ (40s, a drummer with a sample case), and TOBIAS WREN (20s, a seminarian, his collar a size too big).
At the head of the table, apart, sits a woman in a trail-worn duster, NELL HAWTHORNE-BEAR (40s).
She has not touched her stew.
Is it always this wet in the territory?
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: Only when somebody's about to die.
units.name: AMOS

units.text: Mr. Griswold, that's not funny.
units.name: ISIDRO

units.text: Wasn't meant to be.
units.name: AMOS

units.text: Is there a church within fifty miles?
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: There's a hole. Used to be a church.
units.name: AMOS

units.text: Does anyone here carry a firearm?
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: I do.
units.name: NELL

units.text: They all look at her.
She lifts the lid of her stew bowl, peers inside, and sets it down again.
For what purpose, ma'am?
units.name: ISIDRO

units.text: The usual.
units.name: NELL

units.text: More bread, anyone?
units.name: AMOS

units.text: Sit down, Amos.
units.name: NELL

units.text: He does.
The man who sold you this stew is not the man whose name is on the door.
units.name: NELL

units.text: I don't know what you --
units.name: AMOS

units.text: I buried the real Amos Griswold in March. Wasn't a pretty burying.
units.name: NELL

units.text: Nobody moves.
The lamp gutters.
Isidro's hand slides slowly toward his sample case.
Don't.
units.name: NELL

units.text: Madam, I --
units.name: ISIDRO

units.text: I've no quarrel with the three of you. It's only him.
units.name: NELL

units.text: Amos laughs, a dry hoarse sound, and reaches under the table.
Nell is faster.
A single shot, loud as a door slamming, and the gun in his hand skitters across the floor.
He sits very still, clutching his wrist, and for the first time he looks his real age.
Who sent you?
units.name: AMOS

units.text: Nobody. I came on my own.
units.name: NELL

units.text: She stands, holsters the revolver, and turns to the others.
Finish your supper. The stage leaves at dawn.
units.name: NELL
